Home / Help
Help

What do you need help with?

Quick answers about your application, documents and repayments.

Common questions

Check my account
What happens after I apply?

Your application is reviewed. You can see its current status in your account.

What documents do I need?

The application shows the documents needed for your application. If an existing document can be reused, you will not be asked to upload it again.

Why do you ask about my expenses?

Income and normal monthly expenses are used for the affordability assessment.

Can I change my personal details?

Yes. Log in and open My details to update your saved contact and residential information.

Where do I see my application or loan?

Log in to your account. Applications and loans are kept in separate tabs so you can find them quickly.

Where will my loan documents appear?

Documents linked to an active or previous loan are shown inside that loan in your account.

Short answers to the questions customers usually need before applying.

Does applying mean I am approved?

No. Approval depends on the required affordability, identity, credit and other applicable checks.

Will I see the repayment before I accept?

Yes. The applicable repayment information should be shown before you accept an approved loan.

What documents will I need?

The application journey will show the supporting documents needed for your assessment.

Can I come back to my application?

Your account is designed to keep your application and loan information together so you can continue your journey.

Home / Guides
Guides

Useful things to know before borrowing.

Short, practical information about affordability, loan costs and staying safe online.

Affordability

Why your expenses matter

Income alone does not show what you can afford. Normal household costs and existing repayments matter too.

Costs

Check the total, not only the cash

Look at the amount borrowed, interest, fees, repayment date and total amount you will repay.

Safety

Keep your banking credentials private

Never share your banking PIN, banking password or a banking OTP inside a loan application form.

Home / Privacy
Legal

Privacy

How information is used when you apply for credit or use your account.

Code of PracticePrivacyTerms of Use

1. Information used

Information may include your identity and contact details, employment and income information, monthly expenses, banking details, supporting documents, application history and account activity.

2. Why it is used

Information is used to process applications, assess affordability and eligibility, manage customer accounts, prevent misuse, communicate with customers and meet legal or regulatory obligations.

3. Service providers

Information may be handled by service providers that support hosting, identity, communications, payments, verification, document processing or other functions needed to provide the service. Access should be limited to what is required for that purpose.

4. Security

Reasonable technical and organisational safeguards are used to protect customer information and uploaded documents from unauthorised access, loss or misuse.

5. Retention

Information is retained only for as long as it is reasonably required for the credit relationship, legal obligations, disputes, fraud prevention and legitimate operational needs.

6. Your information

You can update supported profile information from My details in your customer account. Other privacy or information requests should be handled through the lender's customer support process.

7. Website data

Security and session information may be used to keep the website and customer account working safely. This notice should be updated if the way information is collected or used materially changes.

# microlenderSite

Borrower-facing KredRun lender website and client portal.

This repository contains:
- public lender website pages
- borrower registration and sign-in
- online loan application
- client account portal
- repayment and early-settlement flows
- customer-facing payment/provider APIs

Administrative staff functionality lives separately in `ramanugut/kredrun` and is not included in this repository.
